name: Policy configuration validity
purpose: Blocks malformed, expired, or overlong policy waivers so validation cannot fail open.

name: Required agent metadata
purpose: Requires every touched agent folder to contain metadata.yaml.

name: Required agent README
purpose: Requires every touched agent folder to contain README.md.

name: Required agent definition
purpose: Requires every touched agent folder to contain agent.yaml.

name: Required tool definition
purpose: Requires tool.yaml in every agent tools subfolder.

name: Required tool Dockerfile
purpose: Requires Dockerfile in every agent tools subfolder.

name: Canonical tools directory name
purpose: Detects tool content placed under a directory not named exactly tools.

name: Agent folder and metadata name match
purpose: Requires metadata.yaml name to equal the agent folder name.

name: Unique YAML mapping keys
purpose: Rejects duplicate mapping keys in agent metadata definitions and tool definitions.

name: Agent metadata schema
purpose: Parses metadata.yaml and validates it against the metadata schema and required fields.

name: Agent metadata type
purpose: Requires metadata.yaml type to be agent.

name: Non-empty metadata tags
purpose: Requires at least one discovery tag in metadata.yaml.

name: Metadata tag syntax
purpose: Requires metadata tags to use lowercase hyphen-separated syntax.

name: Supported Azure region
purpose: Requires supported_regions values to use recognized Azure region aliases.

name: Publisher contact email
purpose: Requires publisher.contact to be a syntactically valid email address.

name: Publisher support URL
purpose: Requires publisher.support_url to use HTTPS.

name: Agent definition schema
purpose: Parses agent.yaml and validates it against the agent definition schema.

name: Prompt agent kind
purpose: Permits only prompt agent definitions.

name: Required agent instructions
purpose: Requires non-empty instructions in agent.yaml.

name: Agent name syntax
purpose: Requires an agent name that starts with a letter and contains only letters digits hyphens or underscores.

name: Tool definition schema
purpose: Parses tool.yaml and validates it against the tool definition schema.

name: Tool infrastructure references
purpose: Requires every action and code environment infra_node to reference an existing infra name.

name: Semantic version syntax
purpose: Requires authored metadata agent and tool versions to use semantic version syntax.

name: Associated tool path existence
purpose: Requires every metadata.yaml associated_tools path to identify an existing directory.

name: Associated tool declaration completeness
purpose: Requires associated_tools and on-disk tools subfolders to agree.

name: Discovery extensions for tools
purpose: Requires agent.yaml discoveryExtensions when the agent has a tools directory.

name: Publisher party value
purpose: Restricts optional publisher.party to 1p or 3p.

name: Unique tool identifiers
purpose: Rejects duplicate infra names action names output names and inline-file mount paths in tool.yaml.

name: Defined required tool inputs
purpose: Requires every required action input to exist under input_schema.properties.

name: Agent instruction size
purpose: Limits agent instructions to 32000 characters.

name: Deployment-time ACR placeholder
purpose: Requires tool images to use the {name}.azurecr.io deployment placeholder instead of a hardcoded registry.

name: Metadata description length
purpose: Requires agent descriptions to contain between 10 and 500 characters.

name: Agent README minimum size
purpose: Rejects agent README files smaller than 100 bytes.

name: Content-based binary prohibition
purpose: Blocks binary files under agents and starter-kits by inspecting content rather than trusting the extension.

name: Model weight safety
purpose: Requires model weights to use Git LFS, remain within 5 GB, match their declared format, and pass pickle import checks where applicable.

name: OS and editor artifact prohibition
purpose: Blocks hidden environment files and common OS or editor artifacts.

name: Generated registry integrity
purpose: Blocks hand edits to generated .auto-registry content except the trusted registry refresh bot flow.

name: Scratch artifact prohibition
purpose: Blocks deployer scratch content under agents/tmp and starter-kits/tmp.

name: Approved Docker base images
purpose: Requires Dockerfile base images to come from approved registries or publisher namespaces.

name: Approved source file types
purpose: Requires contributed files to use an approved source extension filename or exempt directory.

name: Image and SVG safety
purpose: Requires images to match their filename format and rejects active or remote content in SVG files.

name: Pinned Docker base image tags
purpose: Warns when Dockerfile base images use floating tags instead of explicit versions.

name: Public webpage reachability
purpose: Requires governed catalog webpage URLs to use HTTPS, resolve only to public addresses, follow bounded redirects, and return HTML.

name: Contact email domain DNS
purpose: Requires catalog contact domains to publish usable public mail or fallback DNS records.

name: Safe UTF-8 source text
purpose: Rejects malformed UTF-8 and unsafe invisible control private-use or noncharacter code points.

name: Contributor path scope
purpose: Restricts public contributors to catalog content and documentation while protecting trusted automation schemas configuration and utilities.

name: README minimum content
purpose: Requires a non-empty README with at least 50 non-whitespace characters.

name: README top-level heading
purpose: Requires an agent README to contain a top-level heading.

name: README overview section
purpose: Requires an Overview or Description section.

name: README usage section
purpose: Requires a Usage or Getting Started section.

name: README prerequisites section
purpose: Requires a Prerequisites section.

name: No unresolved placeholders
purpose: Rejects TODO FIXME and XXX markers outside fenced code in README and agent YAML files.

name: README architecture section
purpose: Requires an Architecture or How it works section.

name: README tools section
purpose: Requires a Tools section when an agent has a tools directory.

name: README configuration section
purpose: Requires a Configuration or Parameters section.

name: README limitations section
purpose: Requires a Known Limitations or Limitations section.

name: README contributing guidance
purpose: Requires a Contributing section or a reference to CONTRIBUTING.md.

name: Controlled tag vocabulary
purpose: Requires declared metadata tags to exist in the controlled vocabulary.

name: Reserved computed tag namespaces
purpose: Prevents authors from declaring tags in namespaces computed by CI.

name: Starter-kit manifest schema
purpose: Validates kit.json against the starter-kit JSON schema.

name: Starter-kit folder and name match
purpose: Requires kit.json name to equal its parent directory name.

name: Single required primary agent
purpose: Requires exactly one agentRef with role primary and required true.

name: Unique starter-kit agent references
purpose: Rejects duplicate agentRef ref values.

name: Starter-kit folder contents
purpose: Requires a starter-kit folder to contain only kit.json.

name: Starter-kit agent reference integrity
purpose: Requires active starter-kit agent references to resolve in a dry-run agent registry and reports missing archived references as warnings.

name: New starter-kit lifecycle
purpose: Requires newly added starter kits to use lifecycle active.

name: Starter-kit remote asset URLs
purpose: Requires starter-kit logos and screenshots to use HTTPS URLs.

name: Globally unique starter-kit names
purpose: Rejects duplicate kit.json names across starter kits.

name: Agent schema JSON syntax
purpose: Requires agent metadata tool and common schema files to be valid JSON.

name: Agent schema Draft 7 validity
purpose: Requires agent metadata tool and common schemas to be valid JSON Schema Draft 7.

name: Full metadata schema regression
purpose: Validates every existing agents/*/metadata.yaml against an updated metadata schema.

name: Full agent schema regression
purpose: Validates every existing agents/*/agent.yaml against an updated agent schema.

name: Full tool schema regression
purpose: Validates every existing agents/*/tools/*/tool.yaml against an updated tool schema.

name: Starter-kit schema JSON syntax
purpose: Requires starter-kit schema files to be valid JSON.

name: Starter-kit schema Draft 7 validity
purpose: Requires starter-kit schemas to be valid JSON Schema Draft 7.

name: Full starter-kit schema regression
purpose: Validates every existing starter-kit manifest against an updated starter-kit schema.

name: Verified secret scan
purpose: Blocks a PR when TruffleHog identifies a verified credential in the changed history.

name: Unverified secret audit
purpose: Reports unverified or high-entropy TruffleHog findings without blocking the PR.

name: PR validation orchestrator
purpose: Runs contributor-scope, structural, schema, policy, documentation, and modular-rule checks against changed catalog content.

name: Modular rule registry
purpose: Discovers modular rules and applies expiring waivers plus the pre-existing violation ratchet.

name: Starter-kit validation orchestrator
purpose: Runs schema structural reference lifecycle asset and duplicate-name checks for changed starter kits.

name: Agent removal impact validator
purpose: Blocks agent removals that leave required active starter-kit references unresolved.

name: Dependency review
purpose: Blocks newly introduced vulnerable dependency changes according to GitHub dependency review policy.

name: CodeQL scan
purpose: Analyzes contributed Python and JavaScript or TypeScript for code security findings.

name: DevSkim scan
purpose: Scans agent and starter-kit source for insecure coding patterns and publishes SARIF findings.

name: Application Inspector capability report
purpose: Characterizes contributed code capabilities for reviewer visibility without acting as a blocking security verdict.

name: Validator unit tests
purpose: Runs the validator pytest suites when validation implementation or governed policy changes.

name: Ratchet baseline drift check
purpose: Blocks unrecorded full-catalog rule violations from drifting beyond the checked-in baseline.

name: Generated rule documentation drift check
purpose: Requires generated modular rule documentation to match rule implementations.

name: Manual PR shadow validation
purpose: Runs trusted candidate-branch validators against an open internal or fork PR as untrusted data without changing its checks labels comments reviews or merge state.

name: Weekly full catalog audit
purpose: Runs every modular rule against the full catalog and reports violations not recorded in the ratchet baseline.

name: URL reputation audit
purpose: Checks governed catalog URLs against URLhaus and PhishTank weekly and reports malware phishing or provider failures.
